observations.initial_state: Frame 0 and the earliest contact sheets show the gray tank/boundary, blue fluid region, and moving/floating bodies in a bounded, recognizable setup; no obvious malformed initial geometry or camera crop is visible.
observations.late_event: The final contact sheets and frame 835 show bounded late redistribution and a completed visual sequence; no obvious early termination or catastrophic explosion/scattering is visible.
observations.mechanism: Across the chronological sheets the prescribed two-axis event is visually trackable: the fluid band/wave rises and redistributes, with evolving body motion and later rebounds/sloshing. The sequence remains coherent from release through late time.
observations.mid_event: The middle contact sheets show continued wave propagation and body/fluid interaction inside the rendered domain. No visually decisive gross wall/tank penetration or runaway particle cloud is seen.
observations.visual_failure_screen: No obvious severe initial overlap, gross wall/tank penetration, runaway particle cloud, camera clipping, or premature visual termination was observed in the personally viewed contact/key images.
observations.visual_limit: This is a visual screen of published PNGs. It cannot establish particle-level containment, UID causality, conservation, numerical convergence, precision, Q-N, Q-E, or production readiness.
